name: Changa
summary: Changa is the name given to a smoking blend of Banisteriopsis caapi or other MAOI containing plants with an infusion of extracted DMT. Changa often contains other milder psychoactive herbs as well. The MAOI action results in a longer and more intense trip (see Ayahuasca) NOTE: There is no standardized recipe or concentration of infused DMT, therefore dosage and potency will vary per batch.
advisory: Combining with any medications or substance contraindicated with MAOI's particuarly SSRI's, MDxx compounds and Amphetamines. Refer to http://wiki.tripsit.me/wiki/Drug_combinations for more information.

pharmacology.en: DMT causes its psychedelic effects by activating serotonin 5-HT2A receptors in the brain. The harmala alkaloids in Banisteriopsis caapi and similar plants block the enzyme MAO-A, which slows the breakdown of DMT and can make its effects longer and stronger.
pharmacology.zh: DMT 透過活化大腦中的血清素 5-HT2A 受體產生迷幻作用。卡皮木（Banisteriopsis caapi）等植物中的駱駝蓬生物鹼會阻斷 MAO-A 酵素，減緩 DMT 的分解，因此可能讓作用更長、更強。
pharmacology.zhHans: DMT 通过活化大脑中的血清素 5-HT2A 受体产生迷幻作用。卡皮木（Banisteriopsis caapi）等植物中的骆驼蓬生物碱会阻断 MAO-A 酵素，减缓 DMT 的分解，因此可能让作用更长、更强。

uses.en: It is smoked for its psychedelic effects, both recreationally and in spiritual settings.
uses.zh: 它被以抽吸方式使用，以獲得迷幻作用，用途包括娛樂與靈性活動。
uses.zhHans: 它被以抽吸方式使用，以获得迷幻作用，用途包括娱乐与灵性活动。

sideEffects.en: It can cause overwhelming psychological effects, anxiety, panic, a fast heartbeat, raised blood pressure and nausea. Because recipes are not standard, strength varies widely between batches. The smoke can irritate the throat and lungs.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能造成難以招架的心理作用、焦慮、恐慌、心跳加快、血壓升高與噁心。由於配方沒有標準，不同批次的強度差異很大。煙霧也可能刺激喉嚨與肺部。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能造成难以招架的心理作用、焦虑、恐慌、心跳加快、血压升高与恶心。由于配方没有标准，不同批量的强度差异很大。烟雾也可能刺激喉咙与肺部。

fact.en: Changa first appeared in Australia in the early 2000s. Mixing DMT into herbs gave a smokeable blend that burns more gently than freebase DMT on its own.
fact.zh: Changa 在 2000 年代初期首先出現在澳洲。把 DMT 混進草本植物中，就成了可以抽吸的混合物，燃燒起來比單獨的游離鹼 DMT 溫和。
fact.zhHans: Changa 在 2000 年代初期首先出现在澳洲。把 DMT 混进草本植物中，就成了可以抽吸的混合物，燃烧起来比单独的游离碱 DMT 温和。
